name: AirGuard AI — Multi-Agent Workflow
description: IBM Langflow workflow definition for the AirGuard AI multi-agent pipeline.
note: Import this file into IBM Langflow (https://langflow.ibm.com) to visualise and run the AI workflow.

nodes.label: User City Input
nodes.description: Accepts the city name from the user (e.g. Bhilai, Raipur, Delhi, Mumbai)

nodes.label: AQI Data Agent
nodes.description: Fetches real-time AQI data from WAQI API or uses mock data fallback.

nodes.label: AQI Interpreter (watsonx)
nodes.description: Uses IBM watsonx Granite to generate a plain-language AQI interpretation.
nodes.prompt_template: Given the AQI data: {aqi_data}. Explain in 2-3 simple sentences what the air quality means for a resident.

nodes.label: User Profile Input
nodes.description: Collects user age group, activity level, and health sensitivity.

nodes.label: Health Advisory Agent
nodes.description: Generates personalized health recommendations based on AQI + user profile.

nodes.label: RAG Knowledge Base
nodes.description: Retrieves relevant air-quality guidance from curated knowledge base.

nodes.label: Forecasting Agent
nodes.description: Analyzes AQI trends and predicts next 5 days of air quality risk.

nodes.label: Community Action Agent
nodes.description: Suggests community-level actions based on AQI level.

nodes.label: Orchestrator / Supervisor Agent (IBM Orchestrate)
nodes.description: Coordinates all agent outputs and compiles the Daily Action Plan.

nodes.label: Dashboard Output
nodes.description: Final structured output sent to the frontend dashboard.

ibm_config.note: Set IBM_WATSONX_API_KEY, IBM_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID in .env to activate live IBM models.
